spawn_rule: Enemies spawn only from matching map locations/anchors defined by SPAWN_LOCATION_1/2/3. Examples: skeletons and zombies at graves/coffins; humans at houses or other suitable human structures.
notes: Schema stored exactly as supplied by the user.
WAVE is intended to represent the first wave from which the mob can enter the spawn pool unless a later rule overrides this.
BASE_DAMAGE together with DAMAGE_TYPE defines the normal attack's base damage component.
ATTACK_STATUS, STATUS_CHANCE and ATTACK_STATUS_STACK define status application by the normal attack.
STATUS_ID is currently reserved for status data associated with SPECIAL_ATTACK so it does not duplicate ATTACK_STATUS semantics.
RESISTANCE remains a single field until its exact structured format is finalized.
SOUND_NAME is the regular mob sound reference; SOUND_DEATH_NAME is the death sound reference.
